First, 46 weeks and 2 days = 46 × 7 + 2 = 322 + 2 = 324 days.  
Start date: 1793-09-23.  
Add 324 days:  
From 1793-09-23 to 1794-09-23 is 365 days (1794 not a leap year).  
324 days before that is 365 - 324 = 41 days before 1794-09-23.  
September 23 minus 41 days: back 8 days to Sep 15, then 33 more days back into August:  
Aug has 31 days, so Sep 15 minus 8 days = Sep 7, minus another 33 days: from Sep 7 back 7 days = Aug 31, back another 26 days = Aug 5.  
Thus 1794-09-23 minus 324 days = 1794-08-05.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1794-08-05
